headline: Akamai (AKAM) Joins Tenzai To Bring Instant Vulnerability Mitigation To The Edge
summary: Tenzai has integrated its autonomous AI hacker platform with Akamai Technologies' Web Application Firewall for immediate vulnerability mitigation. The integration connects Tenzai's automated threat detection with Akamai's edge security infrastructure to trigger rapid defensive responses. This development positions Akamai Technologies as a core infrastructure partner for organizations pursuing machine speed cybersecurity workflows.
